**Pipeline controller notification**
This repo is configured to use the [pipeline controller](https://docs.ci.openshift.org/how-tos/creating-a-pipeline/). Second-stage tests will be triggered either automatically or after lgtm label is added, depending on the repository configuration. The pipeline controller will automatically detect which contexts are required and will utilize `/test` Prow commands to trigger the second stage.

For optional jobs, comment `/test ?` to see a list of all defined jobs. To trigger manually all jobs from second stage use `/pipeline required` command. 

This repository is configured in: LGTM mode

> [!NOTE] > ## Reviews paused > > It looks like this branch is under active development. To avoid overwhelming you with review comments due to an influx of new commits, CodeRabbit has automatically paused this review. You can configure this behavior by changing the `reviews.auto_review.auto_pause_after_reviewed_commits` setting. > > Use the following commands to manage reviews: > - `@coderabbitai resume` to resume automatic reviews. > - `@coderabbitai review` to trigger a single review. > > Use the checkboxes below for quick actions: > - [ ] ▶️ Resume reviews > - [ ] 🔍 Trigger review ## Walkthrough Reworks e2e diagnostics to collect context-bound diagnostic strings (returned by helpers instead of writing to GinkgoWriter), store per-spec diagnostics, thread a 5-minute timeout context through diagnostic collection calls, remove per-helper panic recover wrappers, inject stored diagnostics into JUnit failure messages, and add unit tests and test-invocation tweaks. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Diagnostic collection helpers**
`e2e/e2e_common.go`|Adds an unexported package-level `specDiagnostics` map; replaces `dumpTrackedResources()` with `collectTrackedResourceDiagnostics(parentCtx context.Context) string` that builds and returns diagnostics text using a derived `context.WithTimeout(..., 5*time.Minute)` and threads that context into `dumpSingleResource(ctx, ...)`, `describeObjectEvents(ctx, ...)`, `dumpAllAWSMachineTemplates(ctx, ...)`, and `dumpNamespaceEvents(ctx, ...)`; removes per-helper `recover()` logic and stops writing directly to `GinkgoWriter`.| |**Test reporting hooks & JUnit**
`e2e/e2e_test.go`|Adds `JustAfterEach` to store diagnostics for failed specs into `specDiagnostics` keyed by `specKey(...)`; updates `ReportAfterEach` to collect diagnostics only when missing and always reset `resourcesUnderTest`; modifies `ReportAfterSuite` to append pre-collected diagnostics into failed `SpecReport.Failure.Message`, switches to `reporters.GenerateJUnitReportWithConfig` with `OmitFailureMessageAttr: true`, and removes the top-level `defer`/`recover` in reporting.| |**Diagnostics unit test**
`e2e/e2e_diagnostics_test.go`|Adds `TestDiagnostics` (build-tagged `!e2e`) and `withFakeClient` helper to exercise diagnostics collection using a controller-runtime fake client: tests present/absent resource messages, pre-populated `specDiagnostics` handling, and `specKey` uniqueness.| |**Makefile test targets**
`Makefile`|`unit` target now runs `go test -count=1 -race -run TestDiagnostics ./e2e/...` in addition to existing unit steps; `e2e` target prepends `GINKGO_EXTRA_ARGS="--tags=e2e $(GINKGO_EXTRA_ARGS)"` to the e2e invocation.| |**Test script parallelism**
`hack/test.sh`|When `TEST_DIRS` contains `e2e`, clears `PARALLEL_FLAG` so Ginkgo is invoked without `-p/--procs` for e2e runs; other script behavior unchanged.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~45 minutes

The required threshold is 80.00%. | Write docstrings for the functions missing them to satisfy the coverage threshold. | | Title check | ❓ Inconclusive | The title 'Update e2e diagnostics' is vague and generic, using non-descriptive language that doesn't clearly convey the specific nature of the changes (removing duplicate diagnostic output via GinkgoWriter bypass). | Consider a more specific title like 'Refactor e2e diagnostics to avoid duplication' or 'Bypass GinkgoWriter to prevent duplicate diagnostics' that better captures the main objective. |
